name: Wheel of Fortune
description: Wheel of fortune with up to 15 outcomes (input per line: 'count #color text'). Segment size is proportional to the count, so the chance of winning equals the share. Includes a colour legend and shows the winner after the spin. Play shows the wheel, the next step (or the Spin action) spins it, Stop hides it. Optional distributed layout: equal-sized areas, repeated by share count and spread around the wheel.

layout.title: Wheel layout (proportional / distributed)
layout.description: proportional: area size follows the share count. distributed: all areas are equally sized and each outcome gets as many areas as its count, spread around the wheel with no equal colours side by side where possible.
